models.label: Retained basketball plus market histogram boosting

current_winner_matched_comparison.uncertainty: Not estimated in this pair audit; three week clusters are limited support.

future_forecast_issuance.qualification: R3 issued 448 original early outlooks for 32 games across 22 current metric roles, reusing 28 existing model states and four saved calibrators with zero new fits. It reused three cached official calendar responses and rebuilt 64 eligible vectors without new calendar requests. All 1,012 known scheduled regular games now have selected forecasts; 24 unobserved regular slots and seven unresolved matchup rows remain outside that claim.

future_source_progress.status: Source and feature blocker repaired; actual model-state reuse and forecast issue remain gated.

limitations: The inherited current replay covers 132 of 183 completed regular games; the market-assisted matched comparison covers 128.
The current new frontier ablations use 139 available games and cannot be merged with the 132-game or 128-game scoreboards.
The leading residual head has no scored predictions for the 47 completed games in the latest seven-day window.
Historical selected champions are prospective shadow candidates, not proven current-season market winners.
Preserved CatBoost and margin ensemble current historical states remain unavailable for exact historical comparison.
No automatic promotions; original-issued, replay and later-fitted evidence remain separate.

new_frontier_execution.result_change_summary: All current paired intervals now use the complete 60-comparison noncontrol family; earlier partial-study intervals used 36. Point metrics are unchanged. The 48 new fits cover 2024–25; current-season prediction coverage is unchanged.
new_frontier_execution.throughput_note: The short executor interval lasted 9.54 seconds, with 47 observed workers and a sampled peak of 30.39 process-tree CPU core equivalents. This is conditional short-queue completion, not the required three-minute full-capacity pass.

qualifications: The 48 new fits complete earlier-season evidence; current-season scored-game coverage and existing future forecast coverage are unchanged.
Current-season pace gains remain uncertain. Earlier-season shooting uncertainty worsened winner log loss and margin MAE at both horizons under the reported adjusted intervals.
No challenger was promoted. This is exposed retrospective research, not proof of provider outperformance.
The actual CPU queue completed quickly with durable work; it does not satisfy a three-minute full-capacity occupancy test.
new_frontier_findings.summary: Shooting uncertainty worsened 2024–25 regular-season winner log loss and margin MAE at both horizons under the adjusted intervals. No positive noncontrol interval in the completed study excludes zero.

warm_cache_progress.qualification: Verified reuse of completed work. This does not measure a speedup for identical new fits or establish full-capacity CPU acceptance.

weighted_50_35_15.ranking_scope: Retrospective matched foundation comparisons only; no all-season provider leaderboard is established.
